payload.summary: Org map files the favourites-shelf DOM test under Data platform instead of Personal practice
payload.detail: Move tests/work-page-favourite-visibility.dom.test.tsx from docs/organisation/systems/data-platform.json to docs/organisation/systems/personal-practice.json (which owns src/components/favourites/**, src/lib/favourites/** and the other favourites tests) and run npm run check:organisation. Why: it tests favourites storage, resolution, shelf behaviour and the add-work-page sheet, so changes to it are reported as Data platform work (CodeAnt nit, pre-existing placement). Context: raised on PR 3507; not caused by it. Owner: assistant. Confidence: medium.
